author: Viva La Dirt League
description:
In a seemingly normal suburb, Brynley goes about her day work day, but when her phone dies she’s forced to confront something truly frightening — her own thoughts! Foneface imagines a world in which our phone use has gotten very silly, and very extreme. 

TW: This video may contain themes of depression, anxiety and mental health struggles.

If you're struggling with your mental health, please seek help. Here are some worldwide resources that could help:
https://movember.com/mens-health/get-support
https://www.who.int/news-room/feature-stories/mental-well-being-resources-for-the-public
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_suicide_crisis_lines
https://unitedgmh.org/mental-health-support
https://www.helpguide.org/find-help.htm
